_about: Starter questions for the shared chat widget (GET /suggestions). Each question names the manual file and section it is answered from; the service serves a question ONLY while that exact (module, file, section) is a published manual passage in the served index set, so a removed or renamed manual hides its questions instead of leaving them unanswerable. Add questions only after checking the answer on a pilot (scripts/verify_suggestions.py). Never reference knowledge drafts or another module's manuals.
